notes.title: Couch Co-Op Festival
notes.notes:
Hi there!!! 🎮 If you feel like having fun together, you're invited to play [b]Think And Coop[/b]! It's a great opportunity to join hands and solve puzzles together in local mode. Perfect fun for those who like to spend time in the company of friends or family, sitting comfortably on the couch. 

We invite you to test the game during the upcoming festival!

notes.title: THINKANDCOOP - DEMO PLAYTHROUGS
notes.notes: Hello, we are independent developers and we are working on Thin and Coop. We would like to invite you to a live broadcast of the game. We hope you are interested in our game! If so, please add the game to your wish list. This will give us the power to continue developing and improving the game!
